question: Does explicit Metal residency for existing exact entropy/index buffers remove the matched four-second-idle penalty without a scientific copy or memory/loading regression?

parameters.cache_state: prepared archive/source pages unspecified, same buffers for all arms
parameters.parity: Frozen Linux BF/ADF/ABF images, complete66 per-mask output hashes, native scalar probes, exact columns and previous-state choice
parameters.memory: Existing buffers only; set accounting, Metal allocation, process RSS, compressor and swap must remain separate. Hold is admission-guarded and may affect actual physical residency.
parameters.qualification: Pilot only. N2/case not an accepted distribution. No default/app adoption without repeated full loading, parity, memory and native presentation gates.
parameters.reference: Apple Metal MTLResidencySet requestResidency plus MTLCommandQueue addResidencySet; no artificial busy work or power-setting changes.

results.decision: 54/54 full66 queries exact; explicit hold alone moves latency out of GPU interval, not out of query wall time. Refuted as a useful end-to-end optimization; default/app unchanged.
results.timing: Case2 wall A1/B/A2 663.079/682.388/660.435ms while GPU649.354/129.205/644.678ms. Other cases similarly no wall gain. N2 pilot only.
results.memory: Metal allocated86,866,247,680B unchanged all54; hold set86,791,454,720B across1160 existing allocations, setup0.391ms. Swap5807.19MiB unchanged; low processRSS is not private Metal memory.
results.load: One prepared archive/source-pages-unspecified load14.193363s plus index4.088624s; not cold or loading qualification.

outputs.result: N2/case/arm; wall and GPU endpoints disagree on apparent gain
